final_repair_contract: Serialized non-audio host publishers stage and validate complete configuration before APVTS replacement.
A monotonically increasing odd/even sequence guards raw parameter snapshot reads; audio makes one attempt and never waits.
The complete pre-replacement fallback is published through a preallocated SPSC triple buffer before the odd marker, including LITE wrapper bypass.
A stable even read returns immediately, so an old pending fallback cannot overwrite an accepted raw configuration.
Thrown notifications retain the captured complete fallback for audio, saves and quiescent preparation until successful recovery. Raw APVTS/UI state may remain partial.
Lifecycle preparation does not reset buffer ownership indices; audio work is fixed-size with no locks, allocations, I/O or retry loop.

coverage_limits: The new three-state positive-frame assertion checks retention after zero-frame adoption, not an independent positive-first callback.
Concurrent ordinary automation during fallback capture is not tested; latest-at-odd rollback and cross-API serializability are not promised.
The second publisher promise proves caller start rather than arrival at the mutex.
Allocation instrumentation covers new/new[] rather than direct malloc or comprehensive lock/I/O traps.
